nodes.label: Duplicate Matching (deterministic signals)

nodes.rationale: One master record per organisation

nodes.label: Frontend Design System (CSS tokens)
nodes.rationale: No shadows, gradients or decorative motion; components must use tokens

nodes.label: Integrations (odoo/, lusha/) disconnected
nodes.rationale: Raise IntegrationNotConfigured; no simulated results

nodes.label: Roles (Admin, Sales Manager, Salesperson)
nodes.rationale: All rules enforced by backend; frontend only hides

nodes.label: Routes -> Services -> Models layering
nodes.rationale: Backend owns all business rules and permissions; frontend is a thin client

nodes.label: Private Discovery Candidates
nodes.rationale: One shared company per organisation for dedup, but found company is finder's private candidate until Odoo protects it

nodes.label: Discovery Providers (search -> SearchResult)
nodes.rationale: Providers never touch DB; failing provider => PARTIAL run

nodes.label: Find Companies (Automatic Discovery, Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: Uses only free public data (Overture Maps, OSM); never shows simulated results

nodes.rationale: Public Overpass API dropped because it was overloaded too often

nodes.rationale: Measures how well sources support a company being real and in the industry, not size or fit

nodes.label: Backups and Restore
nodes.rationale: Monthly test restores so a real restore is never the first; off-site copy required

nodes.label: Production Docker Compose stack
nodes.rationale: DB not published on any host port; frontend bound to localhost behind TLS reverse proxy

nodes.label: crawl4ai
nodes.rationale: Parses pages locally; fetching done by LeadFinder's SSRF-safe httpx client

nodes.rationale: All ports bound to 127.0.0.1 so nothing exposed
